heading: Book a measure.
intro: A designer comes to you, measures every cabinet you want changed, and leaves a fixed quote. No obligation.

steps.title: You book
steps.body: Pick a slot. We confirm by phone the same day.

steps.title: We measure
steps.body: About an hour in your home, taking the numbers that matter.

steps.title: You get a quote
steps.body: Fixed price per shelf, valid thirty days, no pressure on the day.

steps.title: We build and fit
steps.body: Usually two weeks to build, then one morning to install.
